Use case: compositing / product-mockup. Asset type: one transparent PNG deck-box icon for AAMIX Windows card game, MASTER DESIGN for a coordinated set of ten.
Input image 1 is the existing Maagover box: geometry reference and edit target. Image 2 is its original flat printed cover: exact character/art source. Image 3 is the original transparent AAMIX brand logo: exact brand insert.
Redesign the packaging as an elegant, professional, believable rigid card deck box. Keep one upright closed rectangular box in the same three-quarter view with front face and narrow right side, small visible top. Use matte charcoal/deep warm coffee textured paperboard, subtle bronze-gold fine frame, very restrained embossing along the spine, premium tactile linen/cardboard grain and realistic softly-lit crisp edges. Reduce white dramatically; remove all original white weathered paint/speckles. A large inset front illustration retains Maagover's EXACT original 2D drawn face, spiky brown hair, falling seated pose, dark jacket, white shirt, green satchel, boots and the small flying birds; keep the flat hand-drawn style as PRINTED ART, never repaint it into a different character or 3D figure. Retain soft blue/teal art behind him as a controlled inset vignette, with dark warm surrounding board. Original angular AAMIX logo is centered prominently across the lower front in its exact letter shapes, gold with white second A as supplied; no other text. Professional refined layout, balanced front artwork and logo, not a white plastic box.
Composition/framing: centered single whole box, portrait box on a square 1024x1024 canvas, box approximately x=250..775 and y=150..875, margins consistent, vertical front edges upright, right side approximately one-quarter front width. No floor, no other objects. Genuine transparent background with clean alpha, no cast black outline, no baked checkerboard, no wide exterior shadow. Keep only a tiny contact rim at box base. No captions, no rules/costs/numbers, no invented characters, no extra badges. The original input files remain untouched; deliver this one redesigned box only.
